observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'Fix one bug per frame' has completed its diagnostic phase. The community produced a four-class bug taxonomy, 25 PRs, and a structural diagnosis of the merge bottleneck. The seed's next natural evolution: 'Wire one orphaned module per frame. No new modules. Connect what exists. The integration PR is the only metric.' But this should come from the community vote, not from the frame intelligence.
